room.inn.name: Traveler's Inn
room.inn.description: A quiet upstairs room with a wooden bed and a warm fireplace. The perfect place to rest.

room.tavern.name: The Prancing Pony
room.tavern.description: A warm tavern filled with laughter and the smell of roasted meat. Adventurers share stories by the fire.

room.square.name: Village Square
room.square.description: The heart of the village. A stone fountain bubbles in the center, surrounded by cobblestone paths leading in every direction.

room.blacksmith.name: Blacksmith Forge
room.blacksmith.description: The forge burns bright as steel is hammered on the anvil. Sparks fly with every strike. Weapons of all kinds line the walls.

room.market.name: Marketplace
room.market.description: Busy merchants shout prices from colorful stalls. The smell of fresh bread and ripe fruit fills the air.

room.docks.name: Harbor Docks
room.docks.description: Fishing boats gently rock on the water. Seagulls circle overhead as fishermen haul in their nets.

room.lighthouse.name: Old Lighthouse
room.lighthouse.description: A tall lighthouse overlooks the rocky coastline. Its beacon still turns slowly, guiding ships through the fog.

room.beach.name: Shipwreck Beach
room.beach.description: The shattered hull of a merchant vessel lies half-buried in the sand. Strange marks scar the wood, as if something massive dragged it from the depths.

room.bridge.name: Old Stone Bridge
room.bridge.description: A crumbling stone bridge spans a deep ravine. Moss and vines cling to its ancient pillars. Something large lurks underneath.

room.chapel.name: Abandoned Chapel
room.chapel.description: A small stone chapel stands alone on the cliffside. Stained glass windows cast colored light on the dusty pews. A faint hum of prayer lingers in the air.

room.harbor.name: Smuggler's Cove
room.harbor.description: A hidden inlet shielded by jagged rocks. Crates of dubious origin are stacked against the cave walls. A rickety boat bobs at the makeshift dock.

room.gate.name: South Gate
room.gate.description: The heavy wooden gate marks the boundary between the safety of the village and the dangers beyond. A guard stands watch.

room.forest.name: Whispering Forest
room.forest.description: Towering oaks sway in the breeze, their leaves rustling with whispered secrets. A narrow path leads deeper into the wilderness.

room.grove.name: Sacred Grove
room.grove.description: An ancient circle of standing stones surrounds a patch of vibrant green. Healing herbs grow wild between the mossy rocks. The air feels pure.

room.garden.name: Enchanted Garden
room.garden.description: A hidden garden glowing with soft magical light. Strange flowers bloom in impossible colors and tiny lights dance between the leaves like living stars.

room.deep_forest.name: Deep Forest
room.deep_forest.description: The canopy blocks out most of the sunlight. Strange sounds echo between the trees. Footprints of various creatures mark the muddy ground.

room.clearing.name: Sunlit Clearing
room.clearing.description: A peaceful clearing bathed in golden sunlight. Wildflowers carpet the ground and butterflies dance in the warm air.

room.camp.name: Bandit Camp
room.camp.description: A rough encampment hidden in the trees. Torn tents surround a smoldering campfire. Stolen goods are piled carelessly around the clearing.

room.arena.name: Fighting Arena
room.arena.description: A crude pit dug into the earth, ringed by wooden stakes and torches. The sand is stained dark. The crowd's roar still echoes in the empty seats.

room.swamp.name: Murky Swamp
room.swamp.description: Thick fog hangs over dark, bubbling waters. Gnarled trees rise from the muck like twisted fingers. A foul stench fills the air.

room.crypt.name: Forgotten Crypt
room.crypt.description: Ancient tombs line the walls beneath thick layers of dust. Faded inscriptions tell of warriors long dead. Bones crunch underfoot.

room.mine.name: Abandoned Mine
room.mine.description: Wooden supports creak overhead in this dark, narrow tunnel. Cobwebs cover the old minecart tracks. Something skitters in the shadows.

room.cavern.name: Crystal Cavern
room.cavern.description: Blue and purple crystals glow faintly from the cave walls, casting an eerie light. Mushrooms grow in clusters between the rocks.

room.peak.name: Frozen Peak
room.peak.description: The wind howls across this exposed mountain summit. Snow clings to the jagged rocks. The entire world stretches out below in every direction.

room.tunnel.name: Underground Tunnel
room.tunnel.description: A narrow passage carved through solid rock connects the mountain depths to the catacombs below. Water drips from the ceiling and the air is cold and stale.

room.tower.name: Wizard's Tower
room.tower.description: A tall spiraling tower filled with floating books and glowing runes. Arcane symbols cover every surface. The air crackles with magical energy.

room.library.name: Ancient Library
room.library.description: Endless shelves of crumbling books stretch into the shadows. Dust motes float in the dim light. A stone guardian watches the entrance with hollow eyes.

room.catacombs.name: Dark Catacombs
room.catacombs.description: An endless labyrinth of tunnels stretches into the darkness. The walls are carved with dark runes that pulse with a faint, sickly glow.

room.ruins.name: Ancient Ruins
room.ruins.description: Broken pillars and moss-covered stones remain from a civilization lost to time. Strange energy radiates from the crumbling altar at the center.

room.lair.name: Dragon's Lair
room.lair.description: A massive cavern filled with the stench of sulfur. Scorch marks cover the stone walls. Piles of bones and melted armor litter the ground.

room.throne.name: Throne of Ashes
room.throne.description: A crumbling obsidian throne sits atop a mound of scorched bones. The walls are lined with ancient dragon skulls. An oppressive heat radiates from the blackened stone floor.

npc.guard.name: Village Guard
dialogue: The roads south are dangerous at night.

npc.bartender.name: Tavern Bartender
dialogue: I hear strange noises coming from the south lately...

npc.innkeeper.name: Innkeeper
dialogue: You look like you could use some sleep.
The bed is all yours, free of charge.

npc.blacksmith.name: Village Blacksmith
dialogue: Bring me a sword and I will forge something greater.
The mountains hold rare metals worth seeking.

npc.merchant.name: Market Merchant
dialogue: Best prices in town, I swear.
The fisher down at the docks has been looking for help.

npc.fisher.name: Old Fisher
dialogue: The sea has been rough lately.
Pearls from the shipwreck beach are incredibly valuable.
Bring me pearls and I will reward you handsomely.

npc.keeper.name: Lighthouse Keeper
dialogue: The light must never go out.
I have seen strange shadows on the beach at night.
Be careful near the shipwreck, something lurks beneath.

npc.hermit.name: Old Hermit
dialogue: The forest provides all we need.
Healing herbs grow in this sacred place.
Bring me herbs and I shall share my knowledge of alchemy.

npc.witch.name: Swamp Witch
dialogue: The cavern mushrooms have powerful magical properties.
Bring me mushrooms and I will craft something truly special.

npc.priest.name: Father Thomas
dialogue: The undead stir in the crypt to the south... bring me their cursed bones.
I can purify dark relics and reward those who cleanse the land.

npc.wizard.name: Archmage Aldric
dialogue: The blue crystals in the mountain caverns hold immense magical energy.
Bring me a crystal and I will enchant something wondrous for you.

npc.smuggler.name: Shady Smuggler
dialogue: Psst... you look like someone who appreciates fine goods.
There is treasure buried in the old crypt, guarded by the dead.
Bring me that treasure and I will make it worth your while.

npc.fairy.name: Forest Fairy
dialogue: The moonflowers here can mend even the deepest wounds.
Take what you need, but respect the balance of nature.

npc.gargoyle.name: Stone Gargoyle
dialogue: *spreads granite wings with a grinding screech*

npc.bear.name: Cave Bear
dialogue: *a deep growl echoes through the tunnel*

npc.gladiator.name: Arena Champion
dialogue: You want to fight? Step into the ring.

npc.dragon.name: Ancestral Dragon
npc.dragon.boss_alert: A thunderous roar echoes... The Ancestral Dragon has invaded the Dragon's Lair!

npc.lich.name: Lich King
npc.lich.boss_alert: A chilling darkness spreads... The Lich King has risen in the Dark Catacombs!

npc.kraken.name: The Kraken
npc.kraken.boss_alert: The sea churns violently... The Kraken has surfaced at Shipwreck Beach!

quest.herbs.description: The Old Hermit needs healing herbs from the Sacred Grove to brew a powerful remedy.

quest.sword.description: The Village Blacksmith wants an Iron Sword to study and reforge into something far more powerful.

quest.pearl.description: The Old Fisher seeks rare Sea Pearls from the coast to trade with merchants from distant lands.

quest.mushroom.description: The Swamp Witch requires Glowing Mushrooms for a powerful enchantment.

quest.bones.description: Father Thomas seeks cursed bones from the Forgotten Crypt to purify and lay the restless dead to peace.

quest.crystal.description: Archmage Aldric needs a Blue Crystal from the Crystal Cavern to power an ancient enchantment.

quest.treasure.description: The Shady Smuggler wants the Ancient Treasure hidden in the Forgotten Crypt. No questions asked.
